description_en: Queries the supported types of custom defense rules
description_zh: 查询支持的自定义规则类型
name: ListClientUserDefineRuleTypes

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UserDefineRuleTypes.description_en: An array consisting of the rule types that are supported

items.description_en:
The rule type that is supported. Valid values:

1: Process hash

2: Command line

3: Process Network

4: File Read and Write

5: Operation on Registry

6: Dynamic-link Library Loading

7: File Renaming
